description: This file defines the SkillDao class, which manages database interactions related to 'Skill' entities, including CRUD operations and search functionalities within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: SkillDao
classes.description: This class provides data access methods for Skill entities, including saving, retrieving by ID, deleting, and searching skills.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Persists a Skill entity to the database and returns the persisted entity.

methods.name: getSkillById
methods.description: Retrieves a Skill entity by its ID; returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingSkillIds
methods.description: Returns an array of existing Skill IDs from a list of provided IDs.

methods.name: deleteSkills
methods.description: Deletes Skills with the specified IDs from the database.

methods.name: searchSkill
methods.description: Performs a search for Skills based on filter parameters and returns matching results.

methods.name: getSearchSkillPaginator
methods.description: Creates and configures a paginator for skill search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Skills matching the search filter parameters.
